security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* https:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first open-source SQL GUI (Postgres, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite) with staging, Safe Mode, and keychain credentials.
bundle.longDescription: DevDash is a local-first desktop database client built with Tauri (Rust + React 18). Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, and SQLite with git-style staged edits, Safe Mode, OS keychain passwords, and optional AI SQL assist via external APIs.
